messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: SLO degradation detected for /v1/stream (p99 spike > 2s). Threshold breached for 3m across eu-west-1. Paging eng-oncall and eng-runtime. https://ops.redwood/in/1949990000

maria.g: I’m on it. pulling dashboards now — looks like tail is the issue, p95 ~450ms but p99 jumps to ~2.4s. Streaming stalls count increased.

ajay.k: any customer impact? which plans?

maria.g: Most errors are 200 but with huge token-latency. A handful of high-cost customers showing increased aborts on streaming -> UX shows stalls mid-stream. Looks concentrated on cont-batching path (gpu1 pools) in eu-west-1.

ryan: paging history: we rolled contbatch kernel change in last deploy 2h ago, but traffic spike only started 30m ago. Could be mixed-seqlen scheduling blow-up.

sarah.p: @maria.g can you dump the scheduler logs and a sample of long traces (kv-cache miss / batch sizes)?

maria.g: grabbing logs. attaching quick grep output: ```
# scheduler: recent batches
batch_id  bsz  longest_seq  avg_seq  backend
b-1123    64   1024         240      gpu1-a
b-1124    64   16           12       gpu1-a
b-1125    64   512          300      gpu1-a
```

maria.g: see a lot of 64-size batches mixing tiny chat msgs and huge doc-embed requests — that correlates with large KV cache thrash and preemption delays.

ajay.k: is this contbatch continuous-batching? mixing policies should prefer packing similar seq lengths but maybe binning misfire.

ryan: suggest immediate mitigation: 1) disable contbatch for gpu1-pool in eu-west-1 (fall back to fixed-target batching) 2) lower max_batch_size to 32 3) enable per-req seqlen binning with the conservative policy. We can revert quickly.

sarah.p: agree. impacts: throughput drop for throughput-heavy customers but will recover tail. We should notify CS for high-tier customers.

oncall-shadow: running change now — submitting patch to runtime: ```
PATCH: runtime/config
- contbatch.enabled: true
- contbatch.max_batch: 64
+ contbatch.enabled: false
+ contbatch.max_batch: 32
```

oncall-shadow: applied to gpu1-pool eu-west-1, rolling 10% -> 50% -> 100% (5m intervals).

maria.g: after 10% roll: p99 dropped from 2.4s -> 1.1s, streaming stalls rate down 40%. good signal. continuing rollout.

ajay.k: nice. can we also add temporary scheduling weight to favor small-seq requests to avoid mixing while contbatch disabled? set small_seq_priority: high for next hour.

oncall-shadow: applied small_seq_priority on scheduler-level. will hold for 60m.

ryan: we should create an incident note: root cause hypothesis = contbatch packer failing to isolate mixed sequence lengths leading to large batches with high KV-cache pressure and preemption/backpressure causing streaming stalls and p99 tail. Action items: rollback contbatch config, reduce batch size, set seq-priority, follow-up perf regression test.

sarah.p: tagging support: @support-team please proactively reach out to top 5 impacted customers in eu-west-1 (list in ops). Mention transient stalls and mitigation steps; offer to route them to dedicated capacity if needed.

maria.g: creating follow-up ticket ENG-PLT-457 for: reproduce locally with seqlen-mix harness, add binning regression test, hard-fail if avg_seq variance > threshold, and revisit contbatch packer heuristics.

oncall-shadow: rollout complete to 100% — p99 stable at ~480ms now, streaming stalls back to baseline.

ajay.k: assign owner for postmortem? prefer runtime infra + ml-inference. maria.g and ryan?

maria.g: I can own. will write up timeline and attach traces. ryan will add kernel/perf notes.

sarah.p: great. reopening of canary: once ENG-PLT-457 merged, we should do a gradual re-enable with tight observability (trace-level on mixed batches).

oncall-shadow: incident-bot note: incident resolved (SLO restored). Duration ~35m. Closing page. :white_check_mark:

maria.g: quick log snippet for postmortem: ```
# sample trace
req: user-abc stream
seq: 1024 tokens
queued_in_batch: 64
kv_evictions: 18
preempt_wait_ms: 1100
end_to_end: 2400
```

ryan: adding action: add autoscale rule to temporarily reduce batch size under tail-latency alarm, instead of full disable. ticketed.

sarah.p: thanks all. I'll draft customer comms and include note about options (dedicated pools, private deployment).

maria.g: closing thread — will link postmortem here when ready. thanks team.
